metadata.title: Space-Track public recent-epoch orbital catalog
metadata.coverage: Space-Track public GP catalog, downloaded through an authenticated session. Query: DECAY_DATE=null and EPOCH newer than 10 days at retrieval. Joined with CelesTrak SATCAT metadata and known decays removed. Includes payloads (active and inactive), rocket bodies, debris and unknown objects. Objects with older elements, classified objects, uncataloged fragments and most centimeter-scale debris are absent. Some provider epochs are future-dated. This saved snapshot does not refresh automatically.
metadata.attribution: USSPACECOM / 18th & 19th Space Defense Squadrons basic SSA data via Space-Track.org; object metadata from CelesTrak SATCAT.
